policy_scope.applies_to: Replaying lane_b_real_observation_slice.py conflict against collector-only artifacts from the stored 22-slot Federal Register full-window slice (tranche21_fr_slot_runs.jsonl rows + per-run snapshot JSONs for window_start_utc=2026-03-27T16:00:00Z and window_end_utc=2026-03-29T16:00:00Z; task_id t30_valid_002 excluded from full-window population per existing governance).
policy_scope.does_not_apply_to: New live Federal Register collection, new Tranche 21 scheduled runs, production fusion runtime, scanner/dashboard work, or full observe-output pipelines that materialize evidenced lane JSON on disk.

value_classification.slice_derived_bytes: Values read directly from stored collector JSONL fields and/or per-run snapshot JSON without synthetic field injection for replay.
value_classification.policy_fill: Values supplied only by operator replay steps, tool defaults, or synthetic lane JSON assembly for cmd_conflict that are not present as named top-level keys on the stored per-run snapshot and not present in observe-output lane JSON files on disk for that task_id.
value_classification.unknown_omit: direction_hint (and any conflict-relevant field not evidenced on the stored collector artifact) may be omitted; omission records unknown for mismatch math, not a claim that the Federal Register content lacks directionality.

direction_hint_rules.non_binding_example: Observe-default neutral used only to exercise cmd_conflict is tool policy per T60 bounded replay documentation; must be labeled policy_fill when cited in operator reports.

cmd_conflict_mismatch_labeling.when_mismatch_depends_on_policy_filled_d: Any directional mismatch=true narrative must state explicitly that mismatch arithmetic depended on policy_fill or synthetic lane assembly, not on slice-derived direction_hint.
cmd_conflict_mismatch_labeling.when_direction_hint_omitted: Per minimal cmd_conflict code truth, mismatch may be false when lane or contra direction_hint is absent; report as mechanical boundary / unknown inputs, not as Federal Register directional verdict.
